difficulty_reason: Pass from the local relative-curve presentation to locally constant finite R^0 f_* and R^1 f_* and vanishing R^q f_* for q>1 by the analytic Gysin sequence, proper base change for the compactification/boundary, fibre comparison and five-lemma. For every positive degree, first kill the H^(s-1)(S,R^1 f_*F) obstruction by algebraic étale covers of the lower-dimensional base; pull back and then kill the remaining H^s(S,f_*F) class by induction a second time. Retain degree-one RET and r=0 component arguments. Use this geometric local effacement to verify the vanishing needed for the algebraic-to-complex site comparison. The formal spectral-sequence criterion does not itself establish that geometric premise.
